dreamcity.title: 多人非對稱對抗
dreamcity.subtitle: 即時在線非對稱陣營博弈桌遊 • AI Agent 全自主驅動開發
dreamcity.summary: 4~10 人在線非對稱陣營博弈桌遊。前端採用 Monorepo 架構整合 React + TS + Tailwind CSS + Vite，後端以 Node.js 為即時遊戲運算核心，並部署於 Cloudflare Workers 邊緣節點；整套應用 100% 由 AI Agent 自主驅動開發完成。
highlights: AI Agent 全自主研發：從需求規格、遊戲規則引擎、雙端通訊到 UI/UX 與邊緣部署，全程由 AI Agent 自主協同開發並驗證交付。
前端 Monorepo 架構：採用現代 Monorepo 結構整合共用型別、狀態協議與 Vite 極速建置流水線，確保跨端代碼高度復用。
Node.js 權威遊戲核心與防作弊：後端採用權威伺服器視角，動態過濾防透視狀態分發，支援 4~10 人動態房間與斷線重連。
單機智慧 Bot 沙盒對局：自研單人模擬沙盒演算法，自動補足 3 位智慧 Bot 實現即時決策與非對稱陣營博弈。

creativeBoard.title: 多人線上協作平台
creativeBoard.subtitle: 跨平台即時協同虛擬白板系統
creativeBoard.summary: 結合硬體電子白板產品的雲端協同教學與會議系統，支援多端即時繪圖、筆記、影音嵌入與課後回放。
highlights: 獨立白板繪圖核心庫：解耦業務邏輯與繪圖引擎，使用瀏覽器原生 Canvas API 實作純物件導向 (OOP) 圖形管理，大幅提升擴充性與跨平台移植能力。
即時多人協同架構：整合 WebSocket 雙向通訊協議，維持多裝置低延遲的筆跡同步與狀態共享。
工程規範與團隊領導：制定統一代碼規範，主持每週 Code Review，帶領 4 位前端工程師穩健交付。

infra.title: 現代化前端工程基礎設施與極致效能調優
infra.subtitle: Monorepo、容器化發布與打包體積最佳化實踐
infra.summary: 重構既有專案基礎架構，全面推動 TypeScript 標準化、容器化部屬流程與私有套件生態系，實現交付速度與載入效能的質變突破。
highlights: 部署效能極限壓縮：導入 Docker 容器化發布搭配 CircleCI / GCP 自動化流水線，將完整部署時間由 2 分鐘大幅壓縮至 10 秒以內。
打包體積突破性優化：導入 Code Splitting、按需載入 (On-demand loading) 與最小化打包策略，將 >1MB 的主體積降至 <100KB，次級路由頁面降至數 KB，秒開首頁首屏。
Monorepo 架構遷移：採用 pnpm + Turborepo 統一管理多專案與共用模組，減少冗餘代碼並顯著提升團隊建置速度。
私有套件生態系：架設 Verdaccio NPM 鏡像庫，設計支援 ESM + CJS 雙模組格式 (Dual-package) 的內部基礎套件，大幅提高跨專案模組復用率。

equalizer.title: 網頁等化器 (Web Audio Equalizer)
equalizer.subtitle: 瀏覽器音訊增強與頻率調校擴充套件
equalizer.summary: 專為瀏覽器分頁設計的擴充套件，能即時攔截並處理網頁中所有影音元素的音訊串流，提供多頻段 EQ 調校與個人化設定儲存。
highlights: 底層 Web Audio 串流接軌：透過 AudioContext 與 BiquadFilterNode 陣列即時重整聲音訊號，提供無延遲的即時濾波回饋。
個人化喜好持久化：設計頻率配置記錄與即時切換設定檔功能，兼具極簡清爽的 MUI 操作面板。

vegeking.title: 電商平台
vegeking.subtitle: B2C 冷鏈蔬果生鮮平台與營運權限管理後台
vegeking.summary: 面向終端消費者的生鮮農產電商網站，搭配高客製化後台營運管理平台，支援商品上下架、庫存進出貨及精細的角色權限控管。
highlights: 全客製化管理後台獨立開發：主導後台管理系統建置，因應內部無專職 UI Designer 需求，以 MUI 模組化組件快速搭建高可用性後台介面。
全域通訊與攔截機制：利用 Axios 攔截器 (Interceptors) 集中管理 API 認證、錯誤捕捉與全域訊息彈窗提示。

dreamcity.title: Asymmetrical Multiplayer Battle
dreamcity.subtitle: Real-time Online Asymmetrical Strategy Board Game • 100% Autonomous AI Agent Engineering
dreamcity.summary: 4~10 player real-time online asymmetrical board game. Engineered with a frontend Monorepo using React + TS + Tailwind CSS + Vite, a Node.js authoritative game engine server, and deployed edge-first on Cloudflare Workers; 100% autonomously designed and implemented via AI Agents.
highlights: 100% Autonomous AI Agent Development: From requirement specs, game mechanics, dual-end protocols to UI/UX and edge deployment, entirely built and validated by AI Agents.
Frontend Monorepo Architecture: Built modern Monorepo structure unifying shared game types, state protocols, and Vite blazing-fast build pipelines for maximum reusability.
Node.js Authoritative Game Core & Anti-Cheat: Backend enforces authoritative fog-of-war state filtering, handling dynamic 4~10 player rooms and state reconnects.
Single-Player Intelligent Bot Sandbox: Crafted custom simulation sandbox logic with 3 AI Bots for offline testing and strategic balance verification.

creativeBoard.title: Multi-person online collaboration platform
creativeBoard.subtitle: Cross-Platform Collaborative Whiteboard Solution
creativeBoard.summary: Cloud collaborative whiteboard integrated with physical IFP display systems, supporting multi-client drawing, rich media embedding, and session replay.
highlights: Independent Canvas OOP Graphic Engine: Decoupled business logic from the drawing engine, using pure browser Canvas API with Object-Oriented architecture for high extensibility and desktop (Electron) portability.
Low-Latency Multi-user Collaboration: Integrated WebSocket full-duplex protocol for real-time stroke synchronization across distributed devices.
Engineering Quality & Leadership: Established code standards, conducted weekly Code Reviews, and led a 4-engineer frontend team to successful deliveries.

infra.title: Modern Frontend Infrastructure & Performance Tuning
infra.subtitle: Monorepo Migration, Containerization & Bundle Optimization
infra.summary: Re-architected core frontend pipelines, enforcing TypeScript standardization, Dockerized deployments, and private dual-package publishing for significant velocity gains.
highlights: Deployment Pipeline Optimization: Cut full deployment turnaround from 2 minutes down to under 10 seconds using Docker containerization and CircleCI / GCP pipelines.
Extreme Bundle Optimization: Implemented code splitting and on-demand chunk loading, compressing main bundles from >1MB to <100KB with sub-pages under a few KBs.
Monorepo Architecture: Built pnpm + Turborepo setup to unify multi-repo builds and shared packages, drastically speeding up CI and developer builds.
Private Package Ecosystem: Hosted Verdaccio private registry and engineered dual-package (ESM + CJS) internal libraries, maximizing reusability across projects.

equalizer.title: Web Audio Equalizer
equalizer.subtitle: Browser Audio Enhancement & Frequency Filter Extension
equalizer.summary: WebExtension that intercepts and processes audio streams from any active web media element, providing multi-band equalization and custom preference persistence.
highlights: Low-level Web Audio Processing: Built with AudioContext and BiquadFilterNode cascades to provide zero-latency real-time audio filtering.
Preference State Persistence: Designed custom preset storage with instant profile toggles and an intuitive MUI control interface.

Global API Interceptors: Standardized authentication, token refreshing, and global error notification toast dispatching via Axios interceptors.
